questions.en: In which German federal state is Germany's largest dam reservoir located?

timeline.labelEn: The Bleiloch Dam on the Saale in Thuringia begins impounding Germany's largest reservoir by volume
timeline.labelDe: Die Bleilochtalsperre an der Saale in Thüringen staut seit 1932 Deutschlands volumenmäßig größten Stausee
